a: Untitled frames draw an empty heading in rule, divider, notch, tab, titlebar, stereo and plaque, while sheet and well draw none
An untitled notch frame is named by its legend's controls
`<DefaultMotif panel={undefined}>` wipes out the outer default instead of keeping it
sheet and well silently drop `inline` when the frame has no title
The titlebar clips the focus ring of an `inline` control in the title strip
Rule and divider treat `null`/`false` actions and leading as present, and sheet/well as absent
Rule draws its tint edge on the physical left, so in RTL it ends up on the trailing edge
sheet always sets a backdrop-filter, making every panel a containing block for fixed descendants
b: `<DefaultMotif>` given a kind as `undefined` erases the outer default instead of keeping it
Most motifs draw a heading for an untitled frame; only `sheet` and `well` keep the "untitled draws no heading" contract
`inline` is dropped for an untitled frame in `sheet` and `well` but drawn by every other motif
A `well({ label })` styles the titles of every well nested inside it
`stereo`'s extra body inset uses physical sides while the bar's placement follows the inline direction, so they part in RTL
`plaque({ mix })` outside 0–100 makes the whole fill and ink invalid
